recipes.title: Middle Eastern stuffed eggplant, light
recipes.summary: Tender eggplant halves filled with savoury beef, tomato, onion and pine nuts, then baked until soft. Extra eggplant and less rice and oil keep this lunch lighter.

steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 210°C.
Prepare the eggplant, onion and garlic in their listed forms.
Brush the eggplant with half the olive oil.
Bake the eggplant until softened but still sturdy enough to fill.
Toast the pine nuts in a dry frying pan until lightly golden.
Cook the onion in the remaining olive oil until soft and translucent.
Brown the ground beef until no pink remains.
Stir the garlic, cumin, paprika and salt into the beef until fragrant.
Add the white rice, tomatoes, canned, and vegetable broth to the pan.
Simmer the filling until the rice is nearly tender and the liquid has reduced.
Scoop a little flesh from each eggplant half to make room for the filling.
Fill the eggplant halves with the beef mixture and pine nuts.
Bake the stuffed eggplant until the rice is tender and the tops are lightly browned.
Stir the greek yogurt with the lemon juice until smooth.
Rest the Middle Eastern stuffed eggplant before serving it with the yogurt.

recipes.storageNotes: Refrigerate the stuffed eggplant and yogurt separately for up to 3 days. Reheat covered until steaming. Freeze the baked eggplant without the yogurt for up to 2 months.

recipes.title: Mexican chicken tostadas, light
recipes.summary: Crisp baked tortillas topped with spiced chicken, black beans, tomato salsa and cool yogurt. Extra vegetables and less tortilla keep this high-protein dinner lighter.

steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 200°C.
Prepare the chicken breast, bell pepper, onion, garlic, lime and cilantro in their listed forms.
Brush the tortilla lightly with part of the olive oil.
Bake the tortilla until crisp and golden.
Cook the onion and bell pepper in part of the remaining olive oil until soft.
Stir the garlic into the vegetables until fragrant.
Simmer the tomatoes, canned, with half the cumin, half the paprika and part of the salt until thick.
Warm the black beans until steaming.
Cook the chicken breast with the remaining olive oil, cumin, paprika and salt until browned and cooked through.
Rest the chicken breast so the juices settle.
Stir the greek yogurt with half the lime until smooth.
Spread the black beans over the crisp tortilla.
Top the beans with the chicken breast.
Spoon the tomato salsa over the chicken and add the cilantro.
Serve the Mexican chicken tostadas with the lime yogurt.

recipes.storageNotes: Best assembled just before serving. Refrigerate the chicken, beans, salsa and yogurt separately for up to 3 days. Re-crisp the tortillas in the oven. Freeze the cooked chicken for up to 2 months.

recipes.title: American broccoli cheddar baked potatoes, light
recipes.summary: Crisp baked potatoes filled with tender broccoli and a light cheddar yogurt sauce. Extra broccoli and less cheese and butter keep this vegetarian lunch lighter.

steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 210°C.
Pierce the potato several times with a fork.
Rub the potato with a little of the butter and part of the salt.
Bake the potato until the skin is crisp and the centre feels completely soft.
Prepare the broccoli, onion, garlic and cheddar cheese in their listed forms.
Steam the broccoli until tender but still bright.
Melt the remaining butter in a saucepan.
Cook the onion until soft and translucent.
Stir the garlic and paprika into the onion until fragrant.
Pour the whole milk into the saucepan.
Stir the cheddar cheese into the milk until melted and smooth.
Fold the greek yogurt and remaining salt into the sauce.
Split the baked potato and fill it with the broccoli cheddar sauce.

recipes.storageNotes: Best served freshly assembled. Refrigerate the potatoes, broccoli and sauce separately for up to 3 days. Reheat the potatoes in the oven and warm the sauce gently. Do not freeze the assembled dish.

recipes.title: British cottage pie, light
recipes.summary: Savoury beef and vegetables beneath a fluffy potato topping, baked until golden. Extra mushrooms, carrots and celery keep this British dinner lighter.

steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 200°C.
Prepare the potato, mushrooms, carrot, celery, onion and garlic in their listed forms.
Simmer the potato until completely tender when pierced with a knife.
Heat the olive oil in a large frying pan.
Brown the ground beef until no pink remains.
Cook the onion, carrot and celery until softened.
Cook the mushrooms until their moisture evaporates and the edges begin to brown.
Stir the garlic, tomato paste, thyme and half the salt into the filling.
Pour the beef stock into the pan.
Bring the beef filling to a gentle simmer.
Simmer until the sauce is thick and the vegetables are tender.
Drain the potato thoroughly.
Mash the potato with the whole milk, butter and remaining salt.
Spread the beef filling evenly in a baking dish.
Cover the filling with the mashed potato.
Bake the cottage pie until bubbling and deeply golden on top.
Rest the British cottage pie before serving.

recipes.storageNotes: Refrigerate for up to 4 days and reheat covered until steaming, uncovering near the end to crisp the potato. Freeze the baked cottage pie for up to 3 months.

recipes.title: Indian chicken tikka with rice, light
recipes.summary: Yogurt-marinated chicken tikka grilled with peppers and served with a modest portion of rice and cool cucumber. Extra vegetables keep this high-protein lunch lighter.

steps.instruction: Prepare the chicken breast, bell pepper, cucumber, onion, garlic, ginger and cilantro in their listed forms.
Stir the greek yogurt, lemon juice, garlic, ginger, cumin, paprika, olive oil and salt into a thick marinade.
Coat the chicken breast thoroughly with the yogurt marinade.
Cover the chicken breast.
Marinate the chicken breast in the refrigerator.
Rinse the white rice under cold water until the water runs mostly clear.
Cook the white rice until tender, then keep it covered so the grains finish steaming.
Thread the chicken breast, bell pepper and onion onto skewers.
Heat the grill until very hot.
Grill the first sides of the skewers until browned and lightly charred.
Turn the skewers.
Grill until the chicken breast is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
Rest the chicken tikka so the breast remains juicy.
Serve the Indian chicken tikka with the white rice, cucumber and cilantro.

recipes.storageNotes: Refrigerate the cooked chicken and rice separately for up to 3 days. Reheat the chicken gently and keep the cucumber fresh. Freeze the cooked chicken tikka for up to 2 months.
